summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, estimated a medium risk score of 53 for the liver and a low risk score of 35 for the heart [M]. The drug Ximelagatran was pulled from the market worldwide starting in 2006 because of harm to the liver [3]. Additionally, clinical studies were stopped and the medicine was withdrawn from development in February 2006 to protect patient safety [5][6].
